title: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE: stirred-tank iPSC-to-monocyte protocol (not a real publication)
license: Synthetic test fixture written for BioSense-AI; not biological evidence.

paragraphs.text: SYNTHETIC. Human iPSCs (line SYNTH-L01) were seeded as single cells at 5 x 10^5 cells/mL into the stirred-tank vessel with 10 uM Y-27632 and expanded as aggregates for 4 days at 60 rpm and 20% air saturation.
SYNTHETIC. Mesoderm was induced for 3 days with BMP4 at 25 ng/mL and VEGF at 50 ng/mL.
SYNTHETIC. Myeloid production ran for 14 days with M-CSF at 50 ng/mL and IL-3 at 25 ng/mL, and CD14+ monocytes were harvested from the supernatant.
SYNTHETIC. In a separate arm seeded at 3 x 10^5 cells/mL, monocyte yield per input iPSC increased 1.6-fold relative to the standard seeding density.
SYNTHETIC. GENEX-knockout progenitors produced few CD14+ cells at the standard dose and required 80 ng/mL M-CSF to reach wild-type monocyte output.
